report.speaker: Gigliola Staffilani
report.title: New and Old Mathematical Results on Wave Turbulence Theory
report.question: 确定性NLS的共振如何导致高阶频率矩增长，而波动力学方程又如何在各自的初值、缩放与解类中产生原点凝聚或高频能量逸出？
report.reading_scope:
staffilani-icm2026: Entire publisher HTML mathematical body §§1–3, every displayed formula and both figure captions, in overlapping reads (lines 84–536); acknowledgments 537–539 and footnotes 540–548. Selected relevant bibliography entries, not the whole bibliography. Title/DOI/pages/online date/license verified. Publisher PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403; no publisher-PDF or figure-pixel inspection.
ckstt-v1: §1 opening through Theorem 1.1 and its following comparison (pdftotext -layout lines 85–175, PDF pp.2–4); contents viewed. No §§2–4 diffusion or frequency-set proof read. Latest arXiv v2 exists; statements here are explicitly bound to v1. Formal publication title/DOI/pages checked from publisher metadata only.
hptv-v2: §1.2 Theorems 1.1–1.2 and Corollary 1.3 (extracted lines 85–190); §4.2.3 Proposition 4.8 and opening gauge/finite-set discussion (1585–1640, PDF pp.29–30). Not full modified scattering or infinite-cascade construction. Latest v3 dated 2014-10-08 exists and was not substituted for this read version.
giuliani-guardia-v2: Selected §1 context and §2 through Theorems 2.1–2.2 (lines 75–265); complete §2.1 statements and arithmetic-set descriptions plus opening §2.2 (260–345). No toy-model/PDE approximation proofs read.
deng-hani-v2: §1.1 Fourier/DAT/scaling/COL and Theorem 1.1, through Remarks 1.3–1.4 (lines 130–230, PDF pp.3–5); §3.7 final proof of Theorem 1.1 and preceding paragraph (1733–1768, PDF p.32), verifying indicator-truncated expectations. No full layered-graph proof or Appendix C read. Forest 4411–4419 reused rather than rewritten.
pure-four-wave-transfer-v1: Opening abstract/introduction, §2 notation and Theorem 3, start of §3.1 geometry (extracted lines 1–350; follow-up 280–355). Not full geometric spreading/long-time proof. The later published condensation article's Theorem 3 is the authority for the measure formulation and the narrower no-extra-energy-conservation statement.
pure-condensation-v1: Opening through main Theorem 4, §3.1 domain definitions and opening Lemma 8 (lines 1–380). Compared both concentration conditions with the 2026 formal version. No full multiscale proof.
pure-condensation-published: Publisher HTML §§1–2.1 (lines 59–275), including Definition 1 and Theorems 3–4; later read §2.2 and §3.1 discussion (278–394), §3.2 opening weak identities (395–423) and displayed remainder of Lemma 10 proof (425–449) as source-interface check. Rights/metadata lines 1512–1531 verified. No full §§3.3–4 proof, no publisher PDF or figures read as pixels.
mixed-condensation-v1: Model, Assumptions A–B, physical-context formulas and Definition 1/Theorem 3 (lines 60–470); §11 proof map 3960–3980. ST-F05 follow-up read §5 Proposition 11, (77)–(91), and boundary-kernel discussion through start of two-zero case (1310–1495); A/Theta definitions 190–248 and Definition 1 rechecked 410–423. PDF p.9 rendered to /tmp/staffilani-growth-p9.png and visually inspected for (38). Full existence and condensation proof not read.
mixed-energy-v1: Model, Assumptions X–Y and physical context (lines 55–330); Definition 1, Theorem 2, Remark 3 (375–453); §9 proof map 3935–3943. ST-F05 follow-up: §4 Proposition 10, (77)–(88) and beginning kernel estimates (1290–1425), boundary estimates/cutoff setup (1510–1605), final existence-step excerpt (1667–1728). PDF p.3 rendered to /tmp/staffilani-cascade-p3.png and visually inspected for Assumption X. Full energy-loss proof not read. Detected missing maximum-frequency factor between (79) and (82); the model is bound to (1)–(7), (79).
pure-transfer-published-metadata-only: Abstract and publisher bibliographic/access metadata only; mathematical body paywalled and not read. Not used as a full-text proof authority.
local-calculations: Original local algebra, inequalities, measure examples, oscillatory integrals and parameter substitutions are written explicitly in the 4L atoms. Existing Fourier, Sobolev, probability, measure and integration notes are linked.

4L01.scope: 谱参数与几何边长平方关系及固定参数 Sobolev 范数等价。

4L02.scope: 光滑周期解的分部积分守恒证明；不证明低正则适定性。

4L03.scope: 固定频率球加权界及单模态函数族；例子不是演化轨道。

4L04.scope: 相互作用表示精确符号和固定振幅振荡平均；不主张无穷时间平均定理。

4L05.scope: 一维整数匹配因式分解、对角重复扣除和显式相位解。

4L06.scope: 无理谱逐坐标匹配；加权正交与缩放后的欧氏矩形区别。

4L07.scope: 绝对收敛条件下加权四次对称化；有限截断成立，传极限明确要求hs强收敛，不证明全局无限维解构造。

4L08.scope: 闭合四频率集合的导数(-4,4,4,-4)，通常h2平方范数导数为-8。

4L09.scope: 引用CKSTT小到大有限时间结论；频率族构造、toy model轨道与PDE稳定证明未重建。

4L0A.scope: [0,T]上有限维非齐次Gronwall估计，L=0分开；不推出无限时间PDE逼近。

4L0B.scope: 引用Proposition4.8；增长率与对数幂、多项式的比较为局部计算。

4L0C.scope: 引用s为整数且s>=30的Corollary1.3；pi log t时间变换直接计算；不声称任意小Hs初值都有修正散射。

4L0D.scope: 振荡积分与常数T之差上界|Omega|T²/2；可微振幅分部积分。

4L0E.scope: 固定s>1引用满测度倍数增长与较薄集合的小到大结论；不重建算术集合与准共振轨道。

4L0F.scope: 复用4411–4419，核读主定理与截断期望；一致误差不推出积分误差的球例子直接计算。

4L0G.scope: 约束测度存在且积分绝对收敛时的1/4对称弱式；不把形式能量消去升级为任意测度解守恒。

4L0H.scope: 连续、正半轴C1、严格递增且无界色散下换元，4pi因子和密度幂次。

4L0I.scope: 分别指定三篇论文Definition1、测试类、C1原记号、模型弱泛函与边界解释；纯四波任意原子边界公式及C1拓扑未在源定义单独给出，公开说明此来源限制。无存在或延拓证明。

4L0J.scope: 首次凝聚时间的上确界与任意短区间量词；有限测度递减连续性。

4L0K.scope: Cb弱收敛到Mdelta0蕴含紧频段能量趋零；尾能量结论额外假设总能量守恒。

4L0L.scope: 显式两点正测度计算质量、能量与弱极限；不声称满足碰撞方程。

4L0M.scope: 正式凝聚论文Theorem3的纯幂特例，保留支集条件、质量守恒和局部能量消失，不附加总能量守恒；远离零的质量界直接证明。

4L0N.scope: c>0必要性、幂密度积分及具有间隙的反例；累积下界不推出逐点密度下界。

4L0O.scope: 正式Theorem4(i)的纯幂特例，保留两项集中条件和给定质量守恒全局解；N0/CF*阈值源定理仅定性。

4L0P.scope: 有限区间网格及Fubini给出分离对质量>=eta M²；不声称是源文全部三重碰撞区域引理。

4L0Q.scope: 非负积分预算给集合测度界；时间区间覆盖明确另作假设，未将其充当凝聚证明。

4L0R.scope: 1↔m多项式与弱式，强式的-m来自重新编号；同一通道的系数乘全项。

4L0S.scope: Bose因子完整展开，保留-f0 sumfj二次项；仅占据多项式代数极限，不是方程解极限。

4L0T.scope: 一对多测试差对频率能量为零、对常数为1-m，未推断质量导数有固定符号。

4L0U.scope: 二次色散、mu=0,c12=c22=1,c31=0，核与AssumptionsA–B参数直接核对；不等同完整量子耦合系统。

4L0V.scope: 引用Theorem3存在至少一个构造解及其凝聚结论；有限c<1/2、即时c<1/40及幂初值直接计算。

4L0W.scope: 按源(21)定义能量保持初始区间的上确界；严格下降解释额外假设E(t)<=E0。

4L0X.scope: 可用的双重截断测试尊重phi'(0)=0；先epsilon后R，DCT/MCT只作用于端点积分；不交换碰撞极限。

4L0Y.scope: 独立选择quartic模型，R'幂次-3/4，九项AssumptionX约束逐项算出；源深定理证明仍外引。

4L0Z.scope: 引用Theorem2，四次模型下finite c<3/4、instant c<1/120直接代入；不推回二次NLS，不重建能量逸出证明。

4L07.locator: Theorem 2.6; local correction of following norm claim

4L0M.locator: Theorem 3 compared with later published restatement

4L0Y.locator: Assumption X (5)–(18), corrected derivative relative to Remark 1

remaining_branches.branch: Report Theorem 2.10 and work with Nicolas Camps
remaining_branches.scope: Read in full report; ongoing/unpublished waveguide/irrational-torus work is not promoted to a primary-paper theorem or expanded proof.

Pure four-wave theorems specialized to 1<gamma<=2 powers; general convex dispersion and full quantitative Theorem4(ii) constants not developed. N0/CF* thresholds are qualitative in the cited finite-condensation statement.

remaining_branches.branch: Nonradial solutions, numerical domain decomposition, physical experiments
remaining_branches.scope: Report context read; these are not independent fully developed mathematical branches here.

Source C1 topology and pure-four-wave arbitrary-atom zero-frequency boundary values remain implicit at the cited definition. 4L0I discloses this source limitation and provides model-specific equation interfaces. No unique extension to every finite measure is claimed.
Mixed-energy preprint internal dropped-factor/derivative errors are recorded. No claim that the entire existence/cascade proof has been independently checked or repaired.

unexpanded_deep_proofs: CKSTT resonant-generation combinatorics, toy-model diffusion and PDE approximation.
HPTV infinitely growing resonant construction, modified scattering and modified wave operators.
Giuliani–Guardia arithmetic-set construction, quasi-resonant normal form and time estimates.
Deng–Hani layered cumulants and graph estimates establishing the kinetic limit.
Pure/mixed kinetic measure-solution existence, boundary collision construction, multi-scale condensation and finite-time energy loss.
Formal-vs-actual conservation requires model-specific integrability; local identities do not establish missing moment bounds.

metadata.version_policy: Formal proceedings HTML authoritative for report; primary excerpts are version-bound. Pure-condensation formal 2026 theorem contracts supersede the older density shorthand.

source_clarifications.detail: Fixed convention i u_t+Delta_beta u=|u|²u, Delta_beta eigenvalue -omega. Then a=e^{it omega}u and phase e^{-it Omega}. CKSTT/Giuliani–Guardia opposite time convention is converted by complex conjugation, preserving positive-time norm growth.

Randomness occurs in initial Fourier coefficients only. E_event means E[1_event X], not conditional expectation divided by event probability. d>=3, alpha=L^{-eta}, 0<eta<1, Tkin=(2alpha²)^{-1}, fixed regular slow-time interval. Neither condensation crossing nor arbitrary L-dependent observation time is imported.

Radial nu=F dx uses F=f r²/omega'; physical 3D mass is 4pi times its mass. Source constants absorb fixed angular normalization. Mixed coefficients multiply whole channels; c31=0 removes the entire channel, matching Assumption B's absent-channel meaning.

Pure-power specialization retains all source dispersion assumptions automatically; long-time theorem also retains support hypotheses. The finite-time condensation result is conditional on the given mass-conserving global solution and both concentration conditions.

An independently checked Assumption X specialization uses omega=r^4, Pbar=Qbar=x^{5/8}, Rbar=x^{3/4}, gamma_kernel=3/4, alpha=7/8. It is not the literal erroneous example in Remark 1 and not a quadratic NLS kinetic limit. The source's deep theorem is quoted, not repaired or reproved.

The solution definition is imported model by model with exact equation references and C1 notation. Compact test pairings, locally time-integrable collision pairings and source-specific cutoff/boundary constructions are distinguished from unbounded energy testing. No arbitrary-atom product of distributions is introduced.
